The show_song_reviews API returns an empty list for some target songs, so I must handle those and only compare existing ratings where available.

```python
current_ratings = {}
for song_id in target_song_ids:
    reviews = apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=song_id)
    existing_ratings = [review['rating'] for review in reviews if review.get('user', {}).get('email') == 'brenda.webe@gmail.com']
    current_ratings[song_id] = max(existing_ratings) if existing_ratings else 1
print(current_ratings)
```
